wholePhysicalScope: The named Crossley telescope node and 27-vertex enclosing outline on Mount Hamilton, Thomson200’s exact 2019 CC0 photo, and the Lick Observatory installation record.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the segmented dome, round drum, entrance and side annex. Near levels add metal seams, the shutter track and stairs.
limitations: The August 2019 original controls the dome silhouette, pale segmented metal, drum and visible side sash. The telescope instrument and interior are outside the exterior scope.
Annex details, the northwest door, approach steps, trim and roof-shutter dimensions are approximate. The mapped ring controls the annex locations.
Original Mount Hamilton elevations are preserved. The thresholds and rock contact are estimated from the source heightfield.
